notes: net::url is Go's generic URI parser (Parse, ParseRequestURI, ResolveReference, JoinPath, escaping, Values, ParseQuery) with Go's error texts, urlstrictcolons default and 10000-parameter limit. Strings are Rust Strings: percent-decoded components that are not UTF-8 hold U+FFFD (raw_path, raw_fragment and raw_query keep the encoded bytes so String round-trips them, the host and userinfo also keep their raw bytes, so String prints a non-UTF-8 %XX there unchanged); EscapeError holds bytes. Error.Timeout/Temporary delegate to the wrapped error for this crate's error types and io::Error.

Error.Temporary.note: Delegates to the wrapped error when it is one of this crate's error types (net, context, url) or an io::Error; Go finds a Timeout/Temporary method on any error by interface assertion, which a downcast on arbitrary user types cannot do.

Error.Timeout.note: Delegates to the wrapped error when it is one of this crate's error types (net, context, url) or an io::Error; Go finds a Timeout/Temporary method on any error by interface assertion, which a downcast on arbitrary user types cannot do.

EscapeError.Error.note: impl Display for EscapeError with Go's text

InvalidHostError.Error.note: impl Display for InvalidHostError with Go's text

Parse.note: impl FromStr for Url; url::parse is the same function.

ParseQuery.note: Returns Rust Strings: percent-decoded bytes that are not UTF-8 become U+FFFD where Go keeps the bytes.

PathUnescape.note: Returns Rust Strings: percent-decoded bytes that are not UTF-8 become U+FFFD where Go keeps the bytes.

URL.Fragment.note: Returns Rust Strings: percent-decoded bytes that are not UTF-8 become U+FFFD where Go keeps the bytes.

URL.Parse.note: method; the package-level Parse is url::parse

URL.Path.note: Returns Rust Strings: percent-decoded bytes that are not UTF-8 become U+FFFD where Go keeps the bytes.

URL.String.note: The host and user info keep the unescaped bytes of a percent-escaped non-UTF-8 byte (Url::host_bytes, Userinfo::username_bytes/password_bytes), so String() prints the original %XX as Go does; the String fields read as U+FFFD.

Userinfo.Password.note: Option<&str> stands for Go's (string, bool) Returns Rust Strings: percent-decoded bytes that are not UTF-8 become U+FFFD where Go keeps the bytes.

Userinfo.String.note: Display for Userinfo is Go's Userinfo.String
